# Vertiv Uses Cadence Digital Twins to Design AI-Ready Infrastructure


19 Nov 2026


• 2 minute read


-
-
-
-


As AI adoption accelerates, data centers are facing new challenges. AI workloads require higher rack densities, more sophisticated cooling strategies, and infrastructure that can be deployed quickly and reliably.


Vertiv is addressing these demands with solutions such as Vertiv


MegaMod


HDX


, a factory-integrated modular platform that brings power and advanced liquid cooling together. To help design and validate these increasingly complex systems, Vertiv relies on the[Cadence Reality Digital Twin Platform](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/tools/reality-digital-twin.html) .


For Vertiv, the Cadence Reality Digital Twin platform enables its engineering teams to model and optimize both air and liquid-cooling environments before deployment. They can evaluate cooling performance, airflow, liquid-flow networks, and rack distribution using physics-based simulation data rather than relying solely on assumptions or engineering estimates.


This virtual approach also allows Vertiv to explore multiple “what-if” scenarios early in the design process. For example, engineers can simulate the impact of taking a cooling distribution unit offline for maintenance or determine how a facility will respond to a power-grid failure.


These simulations help Vertiv validate resiliency, identify potential bottlenecks, and optimize operational strategies without introducing risk into a live data center environment. The company also combines Cadence simulation with extensive testing and validation in Vertiv laboratories to continually improve model accuracy and simulation quality.


As AI data centers become more complex, digital twins give engineers greater visibility into how systems will perform in the field. By combining Vertiv’s expertise in critical power and thermal management with Cadence’s digital twin capabilities, the companies are helping customers deploy and operate AI infrastructure more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably.[Learn more about how Vertiv is optimizing AI infrastructure with digital twins](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/multimedia.html/content/dam/cadence-www/global/en_US/videos/about-cadence/designed-with-cadence/vertiv.mp4) .


“Designed with Cadence” is a series of videos that showcases creative products and technologies that are accelerating industry innovation using Cadence tools and solutions.
